items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my first really hero was Louis Jordan, the alto saxophonist, and he played tenor, also. But um, he drew me because we had his records at home

ctx.x: Okay. What drew you to the saxophone?

Well, I uh that I was almost destined, you know? I, uh...my first really hero was Louis Jordan, the alto saxophonist, and he played tenor, also. But um, he drew me because we had his records at home, and uh...it’s sort of a weird circle the way these things happen. I used to go to school, elementary school, on 135th Street, 135th Street, as aforementioned. And um, right across the street from my school was a night club, I think it was Elk’s Rendezvous, a night club. So, in that club there was–Louis Jordan was…
And how old were you when you got your first one?
